verdict.rationale: Datadog's integration directory explicitly advertises tracking of code changes, deployments, and app performance via GitHub/GitLab integrations, and CI Visibility plus APM/Incident Management provide the underlying telemetry needed to correlate regressions with deploys. However, no direct documentation of a dedicated 'Deployment Tracking' or 'Change Tracking' feature page is present, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this correlation workflow appears in the community evidence. Missing for 10: dedicated deployment/change-tracking feature docs, and independent verification that regression-to-deploy correlation works well in practice.
